    • hunks

      public static List<int[]> hunks(String s0, String s1)
      Returns the hunks of the longest common subsequence between s1 and s2.
      Returns:
      the hunks as a list of int arrays of size 4 with start index and end index of sequence 1 and corresponding start index and end index in sequence 2.
